subject: Post-call: ZenWell SOC 2 discoveries & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: ZenWell SOC 2 discoveries & next steps

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call today — Dana and I found the conversation super helpful. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the key takeaways, confirm the priorities we heard, and outline next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of pain points / goals we heard:
- SOC 2 readiness: ZenWell needs evidence for ongoing audit (Type II) and wants to understand what Redwood can provide (attestations, control descriptions, evidence artifacts).
- Audit logs & retention: Primary ask is 12+ months immutable audit logs for admin actions and API access; need retention/export options for audits.
- Data handling & DPA: Clear language on data use, subprocessing, and ability to configure retention across private deployments vs hosted.
- Pen test evidence: You need artifacts from our penetration tests (scope, dates, summary findings) and a contact for technical validation.
- Timeline & gating: Audit kickoff targeted mid-May; ZenWell needs confirmation of evidence availability by early April to prepare internal auditors.

What Redwood can provide (high-level):
- SOC 2 Type II report (2025) and SOC 2 control matrix summary (attached: redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf)
- Answers to your SOC 2 questionnaire (see attached draft: SOC2-questions-zenwell.pdf) — we'll fill what we can and ask clarifying Qs where needed.
- Audit log retention options: hosted (default 90 days, can be extended to 12 months with add-on), Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed retention; exportable CSV/Parquet.
- Pen test evidence: we can provide high-level summary and vendor report redacted for sensitive details; for technical validation we can coordinate a remote tech call.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) You to confirm scope of the SOC 2 questionnaire and any additional artifacts required by your auditors (due by Wed, 2026-03-03).
2) Redwood to return completed questionnaire draft (Marissa/Neha) by Mon, 2026-03-08.
3) Technical handoff: schedule a 30-min call between ZenWell security, our security engineering (Vivek), and your auditors if needed (propose week of Mar 15).
4) If you need our pen-test vendor contact, we can share details once mutual NDA/DPA is in place.

Attachments: SOC2-questions-zenwell.pdf (draft), redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (attestation).

Please reply with any corrections and confirm the items above that are high priority for you.

Thanks — look forward to moving this along.

Best,
Marissa
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

----
Note: referencing internal notes from call with Dana Ortiz (ZenWell) and Sam Lee.

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@zenwellhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@zenwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: ZenWell SOC 2 discoveries & next steps

Thanks Marissa — that summary looks great and captures everything we discussed. A few clarifications: 
- Audit scope: auditors will need 12 months of immutable admin and API access logs (we can share exact log schema if needed).
- Questionnaire: we'll add a few environment-specific Qs and send back by Wed EOD.
- Pen test: vendor report redacted is fine; we'll need the contact for a technical validation call once DPA is signed.

Confirming priority order: 1) Audit logs/retention options 2) SOC 2 report + questionnaire 3) Pen test evidence.

Sam
Security Program Manager
ZenWell Health
sam.lee@zenwellhealth.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@zenwellhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: ZenWell SOC 2 discoveries & next steps

Hi Sam — thanks for the priorities. A couple quick technical notes so your auditors can plan: 
- Audit logs: our hosted offering stores logs for 90 days by default; we can enable 12-month immutable retention as an add-on and provide export in Parquet/CSV on request. For Dedicated/Private customers retention is fully configurable by the tenant admin.
- Log schema: we will share a sample schema and event list (admin actions, token usage, model inference events, auth failures).
- Pen test vendor: RedTeam Labs performed our last test (Nov 2025). We can provide a redacted vendor report and an engineer (myself or our security lead) to join a technical validation call.

Action items for us: Vivek to attach sample log schema + redacted pen-test summary once NDA/DPA is confirmed. Marissa/Neha will complete questionnaire draft.

I'll aim to have the log schema + pen test summary to you by Fri, 2026-03-05. If you want the doc sooner, let me know.

Regards,
Vivek
Security Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@zenwellhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@zenwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: ZenWell SOC 2 discoveries & next steps

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround. We'll: 
- Send the completed/questioned SOC 2 questionnaire back by EOD Wed (2026-03-03).
- Review the log schema once you send it and confirm any gaps.
- Please include RedTeam Labs vendor contact in the pen-test summary so we can propose times for the technical call.

One ask: can you confirm whether the 12-month retention add-on requires contract amendment or can be toggled from the console for hosted customers? If a contract amendment is needed, pls flag that so procurement can schedule accordingly.

Sam
